name: task
description: Size-aware task handling backed by the track CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Triage, record, and work through track checklist tasks by size.
interface.longDescription: Incoming work is triaged by size before anything is written: small items go straight onto the project's checklist, mid-size items get a linked plan note first, and large epics are split into phased child items. The same checklist is later worked through autonomously, with each finished item moved into a dated worklog note. All state lives in track notes through the track CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use $track-task-triage to triage this TODO by size and route it.
Use $track-project-intake to record this bug/TODO in my project's note.
Use $track-task-runner to work through my project note's checklist.
